answer: Each agent bonds collateral to a Semaphore-style identity commitment and proves, without revealing its secret, a valid evaluation of the epoch polynomial for each permitted message. Reusing the same rate-limit nullifier within an epoch produces two distinct evaluations; their linear relation lets observers reconstruct the Shamir-shared identity secret, linking the messages and enabling immediate slashing of the bonded stake. Thus a willow, wander, or shale identity faces a verifiable cost for exceeding its quota.
